mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO > 105), a subsequent decline in INDPRO signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 grows, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.5% signals sustained price pressures that prompt restrictive monetary policy, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE increases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a further rate increase signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and FEDFUNDS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
